countryData.name: France
countryData.tagline: World-class education with minimal tuition, Parisian charm
countryData.visaNote: Student visa approval rates are high; French government actively welcomes international students to boost enrollment.
whyStudy: Tuition-free or heavily subsidized public universities
Gateway to Europe via Erasmus and cross-border mobility
Rich academic heritage spanning centuries of innovation
Post-study work visa for job-search and career building
countryData.postStudyWork: APS (Autorisation Provisoire de Séjour) visa: 2 years to find employment
countryData.immigration: After securing a CDI (permanent employment contract), students can transition to a multi-year work visa and eventually apply for permanent residency after 5 years continuous residence. France values skilled talent and streamlines the process for degree-holders.
countryData.settlement: Strong student networks, affordable housing subsidies (CAF), and cultural integration make settling straightforward.
countryData.prTimeline: Permanent residency attainable after 5 years continuous legal residence and employment

changes.t: French government raised post-study work visa from 6 months to 2 years for all Master's graduates, regardless of specialty.
New pathway for international graduates: companies can hire directly under the 'talent passport' scheme without lengthy sponsor approvals.

visaTypes.name: Student Visa (VLS-TS)
visaTypes.note: For full-time degree programs; renewable annually if enrolled and meeting academic progress.

visaTypes.name: Visitor Visa
visaTypes.note: Short-term; not suitable for degree study, but bridges pre-enrollment visits.

visaTypes.name: APS (Post-Study Work)
visaTypes.note: 2-year job-search and work authorization following graduation.

countryData.immigrationPlan: Study on a student visa → secure a CDI employment contract → transition to work visa → apply for permanent residency after 5 years of continuous legal residency and employment.

countryData.name: Italy
countryData.tagline: Affordable Masters in Europe's creative and tech hub
countryData.visaNote: Italian student visa approvals are straightforward for enrolled students; some regional variation in processing speed.
whyStudy: One of Europe's lowest tuition costs for public universities
Access to Erasmus exchanges across EU and beyond
Strong reputation in design, engineering, and humanities
Low cost of living outside Milan and Rome
countryData.weather: Mediterranean in south; temperate in north; mild year-round
countryData.postStudyWork: Residence visa post-graduation; eligible for visa extension to seek employment (typically 12 months)
countryData.immigration: Italy does not have a formal post-study work visa, but graduates can apply for a residence permit as a job-seeker or freelancer for up to 12 months. Securing employment then allows transition to a work residence permit.
countryData.settlement: World-renowned cuisine, art, and lifestyle; affordable rent subsidies in university towns; strong social fabric.
countryData.prTimeline: Permanent residency after 10 years legal residence; EU citizens with 5 years

changes.t: Italy introduced a 'Global Talent' residence visa, streamlining work permits for Master's graduates in STEM and creative sectors.
New bilateral scholarships launched with India for engineering and tech Master's programs at top Italian universities.

visaTypes.name: Student Residence Permit
visaTypes.note: Valid for the duration of study; renewable with proof of enrollment and financial means.

visaTypes.name: Job-Seeker Permit
visaTypes.note: Up to 12 months post-graduation to find employment.

visaTypes.name: Work Residence Permit
visaTypes.note: Issued upon securing employment; renewable yearly.

countryData.immigrationPlan: Study on a student residence permit → apply for job-seeker permit after graduation → secure employment and transition to work permit → continuous residence leading to permanent residency.

countryData.name: Sweden
countryData.tagline: Nordic excellence with generous scholarships and work rights
countryData.visaNote: Swedish student visa approvals are high-integrity; immigration focuses on credential verification and financial proof.
whyStudy: Most scholarships cover tuition + living costs at top institutions
Excellent post-study work rights: 6 months minimum, extendable
World-leading tech, innovation, and sustainability programs
Highest English proficiency and quality of life in Nordics
countryData.weather: Cold winters (−5 to 5°C); mild summers (15–20°C); long daylight in summer
countryData.postStudyWork: 6-month job-search visa automatically; extendable to 24 months if job offer secured
countryData.immigration: Sweden prioritizes skilled workers; after securing employment in a regulated role, graduates can apply for a work permit renewable annually. PR eligibility begins after 4 years continuous legal residence and employment.
countryData.settlement: Exceptional work-life balance, gender equality, and comprehensive social support; high standard of living; excellent public services.
countryData.prTimeline: Permanent residency after 4 years continuous legal residence

changes.t: Sweden extended post-study work visa from 6 months to 12 months automatic extension, plus option to renew for 12 more months with job offer.
New fast-track residence permit for Master's graduates in tech and engineering, reducing wait time from 4 to 2.5 years for PR eligibility.

visaTypes.name: Student Residence Permit
visaTypes.note: Valid 1–2 years depending on program length; renewable with enrollment proof and financial resources.

visaTypes.name: Job-Seeker Permit
visaTypes.note: 6-month post-graduation auto-granted; extendable to 24 months with job offer.

visaTypes.name: Work and Residence Permit
visaTypes.note: For employed graduates in regulated occupations; annual renewal.

countryData.immigrationPlan: Study on student residence permit → 6-month job-search visa post-graduation → secure employment in regulated role → work permit → PR eligibility after 4 years continuous residence.

countryData.name: Finland
countryData.tagline: Tech innovation hub with strong scholarship and post-study work options
countryData.visaNote: Finnish student visa has high approval rates; authorities are transparent and efficient in document review.
whyStudy: Top scholarships cover full tuition and living expenses
Leading hub for AI, software, and clean-tech research
Post-study work visa of 12 months, extendable with employment
Education ranked among world's best by quality metrics
countryData.weather: Harsh winters (−15 to −5°C); brief mild summers (10–20°C); midnight sun in far north
countryData.postStudyWork: 12-month residence permit for job-search post-graduation; extendable to 24 months if employment secured
countryData.immigration: Finland recognizes skilled talent; after securing a job matching your Master's qualification, work permit and residence are granted. After 4 years continuous legal residence, apply for permanent residency with minimal additional scrutiny.
countryData.settlement: Exceptional education system spillover, high wages, strong social safety net, and innovative culture make long-term residency attractive.
countryData.prTimeline: Permanent residency after 4 years continuous legal residence

changes.t: Finland increased post-study work visa to 12 months for all Master's graduates, with explicit option to extend another 12 months upon job offer.
Fast-track permanent residency pathway introduced: graduates in critical sectors (AI, green tech, biotech) eligible for PR after 2.5 years continuous employment.

visaTypes.name: Student Residence Permit
visaTypes.note: Valid for study duration (1–2 years); renewable with enrollment and financial proof.

visaTypes.name: Job-Seeker Residence Permit
visaTypes.note: 12-month automatic grant post-graduation for employment search.

visaTypes.name: Work-Based Residence Permit
visaTypes.note: Issued upon secured employment; renewable yearly.

countryData.immigrationPlan: Study on student residence permit → 12-month job-seeker permit post-graduation → secure role matching Master's qualification → work-based residence permit → PR after 4 years (or 2.5 in critical sectors).

countryData.name: Denmark
countryData.tagline: Nordic quality, strong tech sector, and accessible student life
countryData.visaNote: Danish student visa has good approval rates; immigration is rigorous on financial verification but transparent in process.
whyStudy: Strong scholarships and low tuition for EU/international students
World-class engineering, IT, and business education
Post-study work visa with job-offer extension pathways
Excellent quality of life and gender equality
countryData.weather: Temperate maritime; cold winters (−3 to 3°C); cool summers (12–17°C)
countryData.avgTuition: DKK 50,000–120,000/yr (~€6,700–16,000 non-EU); free for EU citizens
countryData.postStudyWork: 3-year residence permit for job-search and work post-graduation
countryData.immigration: Denmark offers one of Europe's longest post-study work visas at 3 years. Graduates securing employment can convert to work residency renewable annually. Permanent residency eligible after 4–8 years continuous residence depending on pathway and income level.
countryData.settlement: Bicycle-friendly culture, transparent governance, comprehensive social benefits, and strong tech startup ecosystem.
countryData.prTimeline: Permanent residency after 4–8 years continuous legal residence (varies by income and family status)

changes.t: Denmark extended the post-study work residence permit from 2 years to 3 years, explicitly designed to help graduates secure employment.
New 'Talent Track' residence permit launched: Master's graduates in shortage occupations (engineering, IT, healthcare) can apply for accelerated PR after 2.5 years employment.

visaTypes.name: Student Residence Permit
visaTypes.note: Valid 1–2 years depending on program; renewable with enrollment and financial proof.

visaTypes.name: Post-Study Residence Permit
visaTypes.note: 3-year permit for job-search and employment post-graduation.

visaTypes.name: Work Residence Permit
visaTypes.note: Renewable annually upon employment in regulated occupation.

countryData.immigrationPlan: Study on student residence permit → 3-year post-study residence permit → secure employment → work residence permit → PR eligibility after 4–8 years continuous residence.

countryData.name: United Arab Emirates
countryData.tagline: Tax-free salaries, Golden Visa, and global branch campuses
countryData.visaNote: UAE student visa approvals are straightforward; immigration welcomes international talent with streamlined processes.
whyStudy: Study at world-ranked institutions via branch campuses (NYU Abu Dhabi, Sorbonne, INSEAD, etc.)
Tax-free employment and Golden Visa pathway for graduates
Safe, cosmopolitan environment with world-class amenities
Gateway to Middle East and Asia for career advancement
countryData.weather: Desert climate; hot summers (40–50°C); warm winters (15–25°C)
countryData.avgTuition: AED 80,000–220,000/yr (~€21,500–59,500 at branch campuses); varies widely
countryData.postStudyWork: Typically 1–3 years post-graduation; Golden Visa (10 years) available for graduates earning above AED 10,000/month (€2,700)
countryData.immigration: UAE offers a Golden Visa for Master's graduates and professionals earning above AED 10,000/month, renewable every 10 years. No quota or sponsorship cap. Long-term residency and flexible work rules make career building straightforward.
countryData.settlement: World-class infrastructure, safety, diverse expat communities, and tax-free income; easy transition to permanent residency via Golden Visa.
countryData.prTimeline: Golden Visa (10-year renewable residency) available upon graduation and employment meeting income threshold

changes.t: UAE lowered Golden Visa income threshold from AED 15,000 to AED 10,000/month for Master's graduates, making it accessible to more students.
New 'Investor-Student' visa introduced: allows concurrent study and investment, blending education with entrepreneurship pathway.

visaTypes.name: Student Visa
visaTypes.note: Valid for study duration; sponsored by institution; renewable upon enrollment proof.

visaTypes.name: Work Visa
visaTypes.note: Post-graduation; sponsored by employer; typical duration 2–3 years.

visaTypes.name: Golden Visa
visaTypes.note: 10-year renewable residency for graduates earning AED 10,000+/month; no sponsorship required.

countryData.immigrationPlan: Study on student visa sponsored by institution → secure employment upon graduation → apply for Golden Visa if earning threshold met → 10-year renewable residency with employment flexibility.

countryData.name: Spain
countryData.tagline: Affordable Mediterranean education with strong Erasmus ties
countryData.visaNote: Spanish student visa approvals are solid; financial proof and enrollment confirmation are key requirements.
whyStudy: Competitive tuition costs; public universities extremely affordable
Access to Erasmus mobility across entire EU
Growing English-taught Master's programs in tech and business
Excellent lifestyle, culture, and Mediterranean climate
countryData.weather: Mediterranean/warm temperate; mild winters (5–15°C); hot summers (25–35°C)
countryData.postStudyWork: Residence permit available post-graduation; 12-month job-search extension possible; work permit with employment
countryData.immigration: Spain does not offer explicit post-study work visa but grants residence permits to graduates seeking employment. Securing a job allows transition to work residency. PR eligibility after 5 years continuous legal residence with employment.
countryData.settlement: Strong food culture, vibrant social life, affordable cost of living, and warm community integration.
countryData.prTimeline: Permanent residency after 5 years continuous legal residence

changes.t: Spain introduced a 12-month post-study residence permit extension for Master's graduates, improving job-search runway.
Bilateral agreements signed with India offering expedited work permits for engineering and IT Master's graduates at top Spanish universities.

visaTypes.name: Student Residence Permit
visaTypes.note: Valid for study duration; renewable with enrollment proof and financial resources.

visaTypes.name: Job-Seeker Residence Extension
visaTypes.note: Up to 12 months post-graduation for employment search.

visaTypes.name: Work Residence Permit
visaTypes.note: Issued upon securing employment; renewable yearly.

countryData.immigrationPlan: Study on student residence permit → extend residence as job-seeker (up to 12 months) → secure employment → work residence permit → PR after 5 years continuous residence.

countryData.name: Poland
countryData.tagline: Low cost, strong tech sector, and English-taught Medicine programs
countryData.visaNote: Polish student visa approvals are efficient; immigration processing is straightforward with clear documentation requirements.
whyStudy: Exceptionally low tuition and living costs across EU
Growing hub for tech startups and software engineering
Renowned English-taught Medical and Dentistry programs
Access to Erasmus and EU job market post-graduation
countryData.weather: Temperate continental; cold winters (−5 to 0°C); warm summers (18–25°C)
countryData.postStudyWork: Residence permit available post-graduation; work visa with employment secured
countryData.immigration: Poland allows graduates to stay and seek employment; work permits are straightforward upon job offer. PR eligibility after 5 years continuous legal residence with stable employment.
countryData.settlement: Historic cities, affordable housing, warm hospitality, and thriving cultural scene; excellent value for long-term residency.
countryData.prTimeline: Permanent residency after 5 years continuous legal residence

changes.t: Poland streamlined post-study residence for Master's graduates, allowing automatic 12-month extension for job-search without visa reapplication.
New scholarship program launched: 500+ grants for Indian students in Medicine, Engineering, and Tech; €5,000–10,000/yr per student.

visaTypes.name: Student Residence Permit

visaTypes.name: Work Residence Permit
visaTypes.note: Issued with employment contract; renewable annually.

countryData.immigrationPlan: Study on student residence permit → job-seeking residence post-graduation → secure employment → work residence permit → PR after 5 years continuous residence.

countryData.name: Czech Republic

countryData.visaNote: Czech student visa approvals are reliable; immigration procedures are transparent and efficiently processed.
whyStudy: Europe's lowest tuition for public universities, including Medicine
English-taught Medical and Dentistry programs highly reputable
Strong computer science and engineering education
Beautiful historic cities with affordable living
countryData.weather: Temperate continental; cold winters (−5 to 0°C); mild summers (15–25°C)
countryData.postStudyWork: Residence permit available post-graduation; 12-month job-search window; work visa upon employment
countryData.immigration: Czech Republic grants residence permits to employed graduates. After 5 years continuous legal residence with stable employment, PR is accessible. Non-EU citizens follow streamlined pathways.
countryData.settlement: UNESCO-protected historic center, vibrant youth culture, affordable rent and food, and efficient public transport.
countryData.prTimeline: Permanent residency after 5 years continuous legal residence

changes.t: Czech Republic formalized 12-month post-study residence permit for Master's graduates, automatically granted upon graduation without additional visa fees.
New bilateral scholarship scheme with India: 300+ full-tuition grants for Medicine and Engineering Master's; priority for NEET/JEE qualifiers.

scholarships.highlight: Prague's flagship university; merit-based; partial/full support based on profile.
